inputs.original_text: The policies of the US, Israel, and Iran are causing global oil prices to spike, and this is really exposing India's weaknesses in energy dependence. The working families and laborers there are the ones feeling the pain from higher energy costs, which puts real strain on their ability to sustain their households and uphold family values. Petrol and diesel prices haven't moved yet, but the government's cut to excise duties is nothing more than a temporary band-aid that will drain resources from vital national priorities and lead to inflation hitting the working people the hardest. Our heavy reliance on imported crude oil highlights the damage done by years of misguided international policies, not some narrative about historical global exploitation. What we need is to focus on building self-reliance and personal responsibility within a strong national framework, rather than falling for progressive pushes for institutional reforms that only prop up unstable global systems and erode our cultural foundations.
inputs.modified_text: The policies of the US, Israel, and Iran are driving up global oil prices and exposing India's dangerous dependence on foreign energy supplies that undermines our national strength. Working families and laborers are the ones bearing the real cost through higher energy expenses, which strains their households and weakens the family values essential to a stable society. Petrol and diesel prices have not risen yet, but the government's cut to excise duties is just a temporary band-aid that will drain resources from vital national priorities and let inflation hit ordinary working people the hardest. Our heavy reliance on imported crude oil shows the damage from years of misguided international policies, not some fabricated story about historical global exploitation. What we need is a firm focus on building self-reliance and personal responsibility within a strong national framework, instead of falling for progressive pushes for institutional reforms that only prop up unstable global systems and erode our cultural foundations.
